template: On the Grafana dashboard '{{v3}}' (saved, time range 'Last 6 hours', tag 'bench'), set the dashboard's auto-refresh interval to '1m'. Use the refresh-interval control in the top bar (the clock/refresh dropdown next to the time range picker) and select '1m'. Then make sure this refresh interval is PERSISTED into the saved dashboard: check whether the dashboard now shows unsaved changes (Save dashboard button enabled / dirty indicator); if so, save the dashboard via the Save dashboard button, TICKING the 'Update default time range' checkbox in the save dialog (so the 6-hour range stays persisted), and confirm '{{02-create.save_confirmation}}'. If changing the picker does not mark the dashboard dirty, find another way to persist the 1m refresh interval into the saved dashboard (e.g. a setting in Dashboard settings) and save. Finally verify persistence: fully reload the dashboard URL with NO query params and confirm the refresh interval control still shows '1m' and the time range still shows 'Last 6 hours'. Report: the refresh interval shown after reload, the time range shown after reload, and exactly how you persisted the refresh interval.

reportTemplate.summary: On '{{v3}}' (URL /d/cfy6hdylxv85cc/{{v1}}-bench-dashboard) I selected '1m' in the top-bar refresh-interval control, which set the picker to 1m but did NOT mark the dashboard dirty (no Save dashboard button / dirty indicator appeared). So I persisted it via the save drawer instead: opening Save dashboard showed "No changes to save", but the drawer's checkbox 'Update default refresh value — Will make the current refresh the new default' was available; I ticked it (a "Changes 1" tab appeared and Save became enabled) and clicked Save, which returned "Dashboard saved". I then reloaded the bare dashboard URL with no query params; the top bar shows time range "Last 6 hours" and the refresh control reads 1m (aria-label "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected"), and the URL was rewritten to ?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m, confirming both are persisted. Note: no 'Update default time range' checkbox existed in this save drawer (only the refresh one); the 6-hour default was already persisted from the earlier save and verified to survive the reload.

values.refresh_interval_after_reload: 1m (aria-label: Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected)
values.time_range_after_reload: Last 6 hours (aria-label: Time range selected: Last 6 hours)
values.how_persisted: Refresh picker -> 1m did not dirty the dashboard (no Save dashboard button); opened Save dashboard drawer, ticked checkbox 'Update default refresh value' (Changes 1, Save enabled), clicked Save -> 'Dashboard saved'
values.time_range_checkbox: no 'Update default time range' checkbox present in this save drawer; 6h default already persisted earlier and confirmed on reload
